title: RE60026: Reliability Management
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Product reliability, time dependency, reliability considerations in production,
concept of productivity, prevention of degradation inherent product
reliability. Lot control piece parts, control of measurement and test
equipment tools control, raw material control, failure reporting system,
corrective action coordination, Data collection and control, Employee
capability and attitude, Reliability specification and procurement, reliability
apportionment program. Parts program, contracting for reliability, procurement
functions, documentation, vendor rating control, types of acceptance testing,
confidence testing, parts reliability, equipment and system acceptance,
sampling and controls, time samples, cost and audit and survey, organizing for
reliability, management Objective and organization, time phase planning,
scheduling and implementation, typical reliability control organization,
administrative organization, training, report for management, surveillance by
customer, assurance program.
